title: Chicken Spaghetti - OAMC
content:
Title: Chicken Spaghetti - OAMC
Category: Chicken Breast
Keywords: Chicken; Spaghetti; Poultry; Meat; < 4 Hours
Description: This recipe is from Once-A-Month Cooking by Mimi Wilson and Mary Beth Lagerborg. I'm adding it here so that I can plan my recipe list and shopping list for once-a-month cooking! Prep and cooking time are estimates, as I haven't made this yet.
Ingredients: spaghetti; chicken breasts; crushed tomatoes; pimientos; bell pepper; celery; fresh mushrooms; onions; sliced ripe olives; cheddar cheese
Instructions: Cook spaghetti until al dente and drain. In a large pot, combine chicken with all remaining ingredients except cheese. Bring mixture to a boil, then reduce heat. Simmer for 15 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add cooked spaghetti to sauce. Cool and freeze in 16-cup container. Put cheese in 1-quart bag and attach to container that holds spaghetti mixture. To serve, thaw cheese and spaghetti. Bake spaghetti in a preheated 325-degree oven for 40 minutes. Top spaghetti with cheese and return spaghetti to oven for 5 minutes or until cheese melts. Suggested sides: Baked asparagus.

title: Crock Pot/Slow Cooker or Stove Top Chicken Spaghetti
content:
Title: Crock Pot/Slow Cooker or Stove Top Chicken Spaghetti
Category: Chicken
Keywords: Spaghetti; Poultry; Vegetable; Meat; Weeknight; Stove Top; < 4 Hours
Description: A versatile and tasty dish, either simmered on the stove 1 - 2 hours or in a crock pot for several hours while you're away. This recipe is equally good served over rice. Serve with a large green salad and bread. If there are leftovers, it freezes well for another meal.
Ingredients: chicken pieces; garlic cloves; onion; olive oil; tomatoes; tomato sauce; tomato paste; sugar; sugar substitute; salt; nutmeg; rosemary; thyme; fresh basil; parsley; spaghetti
Instructions: Brown garlic and onion in olive oil. Add chicken parts and continue to brown. When browned, add all the other ingredients. Cover and simmer for 1- 1 and 1/2 hours Stir occasionally. Add a little water if required. Serve over hot, cooked spaghetti. Sprinkle fresh Parmesan over the dish, if desired.

title: Chicken Spaghetti
content:
Title: Chicken Spaghetti
Category: One Dish Meal
Keywords: Chicken; Spaghetti; Poultry; Meat; < 4 Hours; Easy
Description: Make and share this Chicken Spaghetti recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: boneless skinless chicken thighs; spaghetti noodles; oleo; green bell pepper; onion; Velveeta cheese
Instructions: Boil chicken thighs in water until cooked. (I usually add a little seasonings, like salt, pepper, garlic powder and/or Italian seasonings). Remove thighs from pan to cool. SAVE BROTH for noodles. When chicken thighs are cool enough to handle, cut into cubes. Bring broth to a boil and cook noodles according to directions. While noodles are cooking, melt butter in a skillet or pan, saute bell peppers and onions until tender. (I usually add a little Nature seasonings here) Add soups until heated, then add about 1/2 of the package of cheese. Cook on low until cheese is melted. Add frozen peas and stir thoughly. When noodles are done, drain and put into a 9 x 13 pan. Add chicken then add cheese mixture. Toss until coated. Spread out evenly in pan then sprinkle with remaining cheese. Bake at 350 for 30 - 40 minutes or until cheese is bubbly. Serve with a salad, crunchy french bread and your favorite wine. ENJOY! *You can use a combo of cream soups, I just like the cream of mushroom.

title: Spicy Chicken Spaghetti Bake
content:
Title: Spicy Chicken Spaghetti Bake
Category: One Dish Meal
Keywords: Low Cholesterol; Healthy; Spicy; < 4 Hours; Easy
Description: This was a spaghetti bake recipe that my friend Gina gave to us. My husband and I then spiced it up a little. (ok alot) don't attempt to eat it if you don't like spicy foods!
Ingredients: linguine; chicken; cayenne pepper; tomato paste; tomato sauce; mushrooms; diced tomatoes with jalapenos; garlic
Instructions: cook chicken in jalapeno juice. cook linguine to directions on the box. mix all ingredients together and bake around 50 minutes at 375 degrees, until bubbling.

title: Mexican Chicken Spaghetti
content:
Title: Mexican Chicken Spaghetti
Category: Spaghetti
Keywords: Healthy; < 4 Hours
Description: Make and share this Mexican Chicken Spaghetti recipe from Food.com.
Ingredients: green bell pepper; onion; spaghetti noodles; Velveeta cheese; olive oil; rotel; boneless skinless chicken breasts
Instructions: Boil chicken in a large boiler 3/4 full of water until tender. While chicken is boiling, cut up and sautee onion and bell pepper in olive oil. When ready, remove chicken from broth and set aside to cool. Add noodles to broth. While noodles are cooking, pull chicken apart or cut up. Once noodles are tender, add all ingredients (chicken, onion, bell pepper, cream of chicken, cream of mushroom, Rotel, and cubed velveeta). Stir frequently on medium heat until all Velveeta has blended. This recipe makes a large pot. We usually eat on this for three or more days.
